text:
maya: Quick sync — product asked for the SI cert to appear in marketplace entry metadata. Can we map the cert badge -> marketplace tags to show 'Redwood SI Verified' on listings?

eli: That makes sense. Need a mapping table: cert badge -> tags, logo assets, and a link to the cert landing page. who owns the marketplace metadata?

sam: Marketplace team owns the schema but we can push a Change Request. I can file it if we provide the exact JSON fields.

harper: i'll draft the payload. minimal fields: partner_name, cert_name, cert_level, badge_url, cert_url, supported_models. want to support multiple SKUs.

joel: marketing: we also need a short blurb (50-80 chars) and a 1-paragraph partner case study snippet for the listing. i'll draft.

maya: schedule: aim to get CR in by next Wed so listing update rolls with the pilot release. eli, can you confirm legal OK on badge usage?

eli: yes, legal needs a quick T&C for use of "Redwood SI Verified". i'll loop in legal and drop a template by Tue.

sam: filed CR-4127 to marketplace. assignee: sam. Need payload example to attach.

harper: example payload below — please use this when attaching to CR: 
```json
{
  "partner_name": "Acme Systems Integration",
  "cert_name": "Redwood SI Verified",
  "cert_level": "associate",
  "badge_url": "https://assets.redwood.ai/badges/redwood-si-verified-assoc.svg",
  "cert_url": "https://partners.redwood.ai/certs/acme-2026",
  "supported_models": ["rw-v1-base","rw-v1-quant"],
  "public": true
}
```

maya: perfect. next: we want the cert flow to surface on partner onboarding checklist inside console (enablement tab). can we put a CTA that triggers the co-sell opt-in form?

sam: yes. console team needs a front-end ticket + endpoint on partners API. i'll draft the FE ticket and add API contract.

eli: partner legal also requested an audit trail for badge issuance. include issuance_ts, issuer_id, and evidence_url in the cert record.

harper: updated payload: added issuance_ts and evidence_url. will attach to CR.

joel: marketing note — badge variants: small inline SVG + full badge. request both sizes from design. also need a partner-ready press kit (1-pager).

maya: can we add a quick QA checklist for the SI before we grant the badge? keep it short: deploy sample app, pass perf gate, verify logs ingestion + security checklist.

harper: here's a short checklist items = [deploy-demo, p50 < 150ms, policy enforcement in place, secret rotation checked, partner_contact_in_console]. I'll add as a boolean matrix in the cert record.

partner-bot: Ticket created: CR-4127 (marketplace cert tags) — viewers: sam, harper, maya — link: https://redwood.internal/marketplace/CR-4127

maya: nice. last ask: if hardware partners require co-branded collateral for H100 loaners, include a field in the partner record: "hw_loaner_ok": true/false and a contact block. can someone add that to the payload?

harper: done. new payload includes "hw_loaner_ok" and "hw_contact_email". will update CR with example.

joel: i'll prep the marketing blurb and case snippet today and upload to the CR attachments.

eli: legal will review badge T&Cs by Tue EOD. tagging @legal in the CR.

maya: thanks all. follow-up: brief demo of the marketplace UI with the badge surfaced on Thu 4/15 11am PT. i'll send an invite. want to demo with one SI listing and the partner press kit.

sam: I'll make sure the staging marketplace has the test payload and that the cert shows up.

maya: sweet. closing notes: keep the cert process <2 hours, evidence can be a short runbook link + logs export. :white_check_mark:
